title: amigit 0.1 -- first git client for classic AmigaOS
body:
amigit is the first native git client for AmigaOS 3.x, built on a ported libgit2 1.8.5. It covers the essentials -- init, add, commit, status, log, show, diff, branch, tag, checkout, reset -- running entirely on real 68k hardware.

The port required porting zlib 1.3.1 and libgit2 to amiport first, plus an FS-UAE trap workaround for a mathieeesingbas issue in libgit2's patch generator. Writeup coming soon.

Grab it from [the packages page](/packages/?name=amigit).
